comment: The INN the interop lab peers with, pinned. specs/peering.md section 5 asks for the tag, the commit sha and the tarball sha256; this build is from the release tarball, so the tarball digest is the pin and no git checkout was used.
configure_notes: --without-perl: hbox has perl 5.38 but configure cannot link libperl (`checking for perl_alloc... no`), and no scenario needs the Perl filter hooks.
--with-berkeleydb=no: the lab uses hisv6 history and tradindexed overview, neither of which needs BDB; ovdb would.
--with-openssl=no, --without-sasl: no TLS and no AUTHINFO SASL in the lab; both are recorded gaps, not oversights.
build: swarm-build make -j4 && make install (as the ordinary user; the prefix is user-owned, no sudo)
runtime: innd and nnrpd run as the ordinary user on high ports; see docs/interop-inn.md
